stem: Which information flow matches the depicted asynchronous front-end/back-end design?

options.text: The front end adds vertices and constraints in real time; the back end periodically optimizes the current graph and returns updated estimates to that graph.
The back end creates every sensor observation in real time; the front end periodically solves the full nonlinear least-squares problem.
The front end must stop processing all new observations until a full back-end optimization finishes after every sensor sample.
The graph sends data to the back end once, and the optimized estimates have no route back to the represented graph.
